title: Birodh
desc: An inspector posted in a remote village area tries to fight against the corrupt local MLA. However, the MLA responds pettily by spreading lies about him.

title: Shapath Nilam
desc: Sukanta is shattered when his wife, Minu, is raped on their honeymoon. Though his wife fails to recognise him after the incident, her twin sister, Debu, tries to find the culprit.

title: Baba Taraknath
desc: Amar, an explorer conducting research on snake venom, loves Sudha and the two get married. However, their marital bliss is dampened when an astrologer predicts Amar's death.

title: Rakto Nodir Dhara
desc: Jaga, an international terrorist, avoids a prison term of 21 years by killing multiple people involved in the case. However, the sons of his victims return to seek vengeance.

title: Pooja
desc: A maidservant witnesses the horrific tortures subjected to her employer's daughter by her in-laws. Eventually, she hatches a plot to infiltrate the house and rescue her mistress.

title: Shikarpur
desc: With the sudden rise in homicides, Keshto steps in to lead the investigation. Consequently, he proposes that the offences are the work of several distinct individuals.

title: Maach Mishti & More
desc: Three generations of a family live together but they are very different from each other. The three young sons learn various lessons from life and end up as better human beings.

title: Kedara
desc: An elderly ventriloquist, lost in past conversations, inhabits his ancestral home. His solitary life shifts unexpectedly when a junk dealer introduces him to an intriguing armchair.

title: Patanjali Yog - By Yogrishi Swami Ramdev
desc: Baba Ramdev shows how yoga can help you. He explains different yoga poses. These poses can make your life healthier and less stressful. Learn yoga from Baba Ramdev!

title: Kari Diye Kinlam
desc: Sisters Lakshmi and Sati pursue independence but face recurring challenges in their individual journeys.

title: Sakaler Sure
desc: Bengali artists love devotional and folk songs. These songs inspire singers and audiences alike. They celebrate culture and faith, creating a shared experience.

title: Sakaler Sure
desc: Talented singers and artists perform some of the most popular devotional and folk songs of Bengali music and enthral the audience with their performance.

title: Rakter Swad
desc: Police officer Arunava investigates false witchcraft rumours created by Dr Niyogi with disguised CBI officer Rajendra. Consequently, they rescue Roni and solve the case.

title: Beder Meye Josna
desc: A prince, bitten by a snake, is saved by the healer Josna, who falls ill in the process. Recovered, she demands his hand in marriage, leading to a royal tug-of-war for love.

title: Kalankini Badhu
desc: Soumik leaves his family when his brothers are contemptuous about his inability to find a job. However, his continued absence begins to tear the family apart.

title: Asol Nakol
desc: After being misled by his brother, Kalidas moves to the city and adopts a new identity, only to find himself caught in a romantic dilemma with his own unsuspecting wife.

title: Boss - Born To Rule
desc: A young man, Surya, aspires to become a gangster. In the process, he ends up falling in love with Rusha, the beloved daughter of a police commissioner.

title: Chaowa Pawa
desc: Best friends Arun and Deb promise to get married on the same day, but the former gets into an accident. When he asks to see his fiancé for the last time, Deb sacrifices his love to fulfil the wish.
